extension_reason: Hamish explicitly requested the active seam be extended from v436-v440 to v436-v450 after v436 v1 completed and v436 v2 had not yet been recorded.

heartbeat_policy.reason: A 20-minute wake cadence is fast enough to observe v1 runner completions and v2 handoffs while avoiding noise from 5-10 minute duplicate checks.

allowed_adjustments.15_minutes: Use only when the operator wants tighter observation and accepts extra wake noise.
allowed_adjustments.30_minutes: Use when v1 CLI lanes are expected to run long and quiet continuity is preferred.
allowed_adjustments.60_minutes: Use for low-touch overnight observation, not active bridge acceleration.

anti_patterns: Do not collapse v436-v450 into one monolithic goal.
Do not let Goal Mode bypass v1 CLI receipts, v2 App receipts, staged checks, or forward-only publication.
Do not open v451 from this packet.

advisory_policy.late_reply_policy: Late advisory replies can seed later phases, but cannot block or replace v1/v2 gates.

external_policy.spend_boundary: The cap is a ceiling, not authorization. No paid external action, cloud write, connected-account mutation, Notion write, Google Drive write, or external-service mutation is allowed without a fresh explicit scope, rollback, and spend note.
allowed_without_new_scope: official-source web reading for source capsules
normal GitHub publication via the existing repository remote
